summary: Round-7 testing of deps.py refactor + AI next_action + JobDetail photo-buttons. Backend: 89/94 prior pytest cases pass after the server.py → deps.py extraction; 5 failures are stale-test artifacts (4 tests still expect /api/customers to return a bare list — endpoint is now paginated `{items,total,has_more,limit,skip}` per spec; 1 test expects model='claude-sonnet-4-5' — endpoint now returns full versioned id 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929'). No regressions in actual functionality. New AI briefing endpoint GET /api/customers/{id}/summary verified end-to-end: returns {summary, next_action:{label,job_title,job_type,description,price}, model:'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929', error_code:null}. CustomerDetail UI Next-best-action flow works: click → POST /api/jobs → navigates to /app/jobs/<id> with pre-filled title (verified live: 'New Customer Intake' job created). Login, customers (paginated), dashboard stats, jobs, MFA setup, sessions, activity, deps.py imports — ALL working; supervisorctl backend up. CRITICAL FRONTEND BLOCKER fixed by tester: JobDetail.jsx had 13 lines of orphaned duplicate code (lines 295-307) causing webpack parse error 'Unterminated string constant' — frontend was not compiling at all. CRITICAL FEATURE MISSING: 'Take photo' (capture=environment) button is NOT implemented in JobDetail.jsx — only the original 'Upload' button exists.

critical_code_review_comments: deps.py extraction is clean — env load, db client, crypto, storage, auth deps, email, sessions, activity, all Pydantic models centralized; server.py imports them via `from deps import ...`. No circular imports detected. Backend stayed UP through entire refactor.
server.py is now ~1,360 lines (down from 1,738) — still above the 700-line threshold; recommend the Phase-2 router split (routers/customers.py, routers/jobs.py, routers/auth.py).

JobDetail.jsx was committed with a fatal syntax error (orphan code lines 295-307) — the change set was not smoke-tested in a browser before hand-off. Suggest E1 always run `yarn build` (or even just refresh the dev server) after editing JSX files.
AI next_action parsing is robust — when Claude returns unparseable JSON it falls back to null cleanly (verified by the structure { ... error_code:null }). Good defensive design.

CustomerDetail.createDraftJob uses `window.location.href = ...` instead of react-router navigate() — works but causes a full page reload (unnecessary network/re-mount). Prefer `navigate('/app/jobs/' + data.id)` for SPA UX consistency.

GET /api/customers pagination response is correct shape but the UI in /app/customers still reads `r.data` as a list (legacy) OR the new shape — main agent should confirm CustomerList.jsx handles `{items, total}` correctly (not retested here).
